description.value: Southside Market is a locally-owned, full-service grocery store in Revelstoke that has served the community since 1977, rooted in the neighbourhood once known as 'Little Italy.' The store blends BC-sourced fresh produce and meats with a wide range of international specialty products — from Italian cured meats to Asian pantry staples — alongside an in-house deli and bakery. Its broad selection of organic and health-focused products makes it a well-rounded resupply stop for cyclists passing through Revelstoke.

address.value: 900 Fourth Street East, Revelstoke, BC Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record. The store describes itself as a full-service grocery with fresh produce, deli, and bakery, confirming 'Basic groceries' and 'Hot food' (deli case with roast chickens and sandwiches). No mention of bike parking, water refill, or cycle-specific amenities anywhere on the site. A weekly flyer dated May 22–28, 2026 confirms the business is currently active.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Southside Market is a well-established, full-service grocery in Revelstoke with a deli and broad food selection — a clear and useful resupply point for touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The store has received multiple community awards (2019 Business of the Year, 2020 Covid Response, 2020 and 2024 Youth Employer), suggesting strong local standing.
